picks.rationale: Aiming translation at a chosen region of your view is a new spatial-UI primitive for smart glasses, and it is the headline feature of Google's coming eyewear fleet.
picks.excerpt: Google is reportedly testing a 'Listening area' mode for Live Translate on Android XR that lets wearers aim translation at a specific region of their view. It looks like a headline feature for Google's upcoming fleet of smart glasses.

picks.rationale: The Fitbit founders' $250 screenless LTE band is a fresh answer to what a wearable looks like when voice replaces the display entirely.
picks.excerpt: Fitbit founders James Park and Eric Friedman unveiled Luffu Link, a $250 screenless LTE band with mic, speaker and voice logging. The LTE-enabled health and safety band is one part of a larger AI-powered ecosystem for monitoring a family's well-being.

picks.rationale: Putting logic inside mobile memory is the hardware step that decides how big a model your phone or laptop can run locally next year.
picks.excerpt: Samsung detailed the first LPDDR5X-PIM at Hot Chips 2026, putting logic directly inside mobile memory for 3x faster AI inference at 8x the bandwidth. It is a foundational step toward phones and laptops running bigger models locally.

picks.rationale: Gemini 3.5 Transcribe turns rambling dictation into structured text inside Gboard and Chrome, moving voice from a novelty to a default input method.
picks.excerpt: Google launched Gemini 3.5 Transcribe, its 'most precise speech-to-text model yet,' already powering Gboard Rambler and heading to Chrome. Rambling dictation gets cleaned into structured text on the device you're already typing on.

picks.rationale: LG and Nvidia generating 100,000 hours of training data shows the home-humanoid race is now won with data pipelines, not demo reels.
picks.excerpt: LG and Nvidia plan to generate 100,000 hours of training data by the end of 2026 to prepare LG's CLOiD home robot for complex tasks. It puts LG head-to-head with Tesla Optimus, BYD Xiao Di, Figure 03 and 1X NEO in the race to a household humanoid.
